properties.state: {"concern":"core","designation":"internal","kind":"functional","lineage":"original","name":"Design intent is read back into a long build, not only the debt the loop is owed","priority":"medium","provenance":"authored","statement":"A long build session forgets what it was trying to build. reflow's countermeasure was explicit: workflow_master.json takes an architecture_anchor at the P2-to-P3 transition — checksums over the service/functional/interface/graph specs plus captured fields design_intent_summary, key_decisions, constraints, service_count, function_count — and then RE-INJECTS it at three moments: phase_transitions, resync_protocol, and every_N_iterations with N = 5. Its llm_instructions make the purpose plain, on_phase_entry: \"Read architecture_anchor from working_memory.json ... Remind yourself of design intent and constraints.\" reflow2 HAS a periodic re-injection mechanism and it carries different cargo. cap:read-loop-hint surfaces loop DEBT when it is real — what capture/detect/ask/decide steps are owed — and the Stop hook nudges when graph writes finish without a loop check. That is valuable and is not this. Debt says what you OWE; intent says what you were TRYING TO BUILD. A session can be perfectly clean on debt and still have quietly stopped building the thing the design describes. The vocabulary for the payload largely exists — Snapshot is the checksummed baseline (14 instances against Anchor's zero, see dec:anchor-retire-or-implement), Decision carries key decisions, Constraint carries constraints — so the gap is the RE-READING, not the recording. Open underneath it: what triggers a re-injection in a system with no phase counter to count iterations against. reflow could say \"every 5 loops\" because it had a loop counter; reflow2's equivalent trigger might be elapsed writes, a drift threshold, or the same budget req:build-loop-is-bounded would introduce, which is why these two were captured together. Found 2026-07-28 reviewing the original reflow workflows. Anthony's word: capture it.","status":"proposed"}
